question: When was Akbar became the emperor?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1556 AD.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Akbar** was the third Mughal emperor.
 
• He became the emperor of the Mughal dynasty in **1556 AD.**
 
• He ruled the Indian subcontinent between 1556 and 1605.
